Marissa / Grace — I've scanned the Novacorp MSA and attached an initial set of flags (high level). Two items to surface immediately:

- Indemnity / consequential damages carveouts: their language shifts burden to the provider on third-party claims. We should propose a mutual indemnity and limit consequential damages to direct damages only.
- Data retention / audit rights (Exhibit A): their retention window conflicts with our standard 90-day KV cache policy and open-hosting practises. Need clarification on which data sets they expect to retain longer.

Action items for our reply:
- Ask them for precise Exhibit A usage metrics (RPS, retention per tenant, expected concurrency). Grace, can you confirm the demo SKUs and any expected throughput?
- I'll produce a tracked redline (doc attached) and a short comment summary for Procurement.

Attachment: Novacorp_MSA_v1_redlines.docx
